feature.headline: Connection workshop
feature.lede: This Wednesday only, at Keystone Crescent, King's Cross. 7:30–9pm, then the free social from 9pm.

schedule.title: Connection workshop
schedule.text: Hoi Ung is an international Brazilian Zouk dancer, now settled locally in London. He shares some of his 16 years of dance experience, including training with dozens of world-renowned teachers, through concepts and ideas around Connection.

feature.note: 9 Caledonian Road, N1 9DX, 2 minutes from King's Cross St Pancras. The entry is the plain door at No. 9.
feature.listText: Connection workshop with Hoi Ung, 7:30–9pm. Free social 9pm–late.
